content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to connect a [product_name] module directly to my laptop via ethernet. I've configured my laptop with the IP 192.168.0.4 to reach the module at 192.168.0.3, but the web page only shows 'Connection interrupted' or 'Can't connect.' Am I missing something here?

Hi, If you haven’t made any changes, please confirm whether your network provider still supports 3G. This [product_name] module is only compatible with 3G networks, and if your provider has discontinued 3G, the only option is to upgrade to a newer [product_name] model that supports 4G/LTE. If you have updated something (such as switching to different hardware) but 3G is still available, make sure you are running the latest firmware on your module and try again. The most recent firmware is [version_no]. You can download it for free here: [url] Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing consistent connection problems when accessing the web interface of a [product_name] module over ethernet. Another user points out possible 3G network limitations affecting its functionality, and recommends checking for firmware updates and considering hardware upgrades if 3G is no longer available.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates stable network connectivity and configuration access to the [product_name] module’s web interface through Ethernet, regardless of changes in external network technologies.
